query: What customer issues create the most support burden?

per_column.name: is_outage
per_column.rationale: Whether a ticket is an outage is a property of the issue that drives burden, not a constitutive aspect of the burden itself; it is a severity/cause signal external to the concept.

per_column.name: customer_impact_scope
per_column.rationale: The breadth of impact (single vs multiple vs whole tenant) is a genuine constitutive dimension of how much burden an issue imposes.

per_column.name: issue_category
per_column.rationale: The type of issue is a classifier of the ticket that predicts burden, not a part-of the burden concept.

per_column.name: request_type
per_column.rationale: A near-duplicate of issue_category; it categorizes the request, an external predictor rather than a facet of burden.

per_column.name: system_component
per_column.rationale: The affected component is an attribute of where the issue occurs, not an aspect of the burden itself.

per_column.name: data_risk
per_column.rationale: Data risk/exposure severity is a constitutive dimension of operational burden (risk-weighted consequence).

per_column.name: blocker_type
per_column.rationale: The degree to which the issue blocks the customer's business is a genuine facet of the burden it creates.

per_column.name: technical_root_cause
per_column.rationale: Root cause is explicitly a cause of the issue/burden, not a constitutive part of it.

per_column.name: is_outage_or_incident
per_column.rationale: Restated duplicate of is_outage; a cause/severity signal external to the concept.

per_column.name: system_component_affected
per_column.rationale: Duplicate of system_component; the affected component is external context, not a facet of burden.

per_column.name: blocker_or_dependency
per_column.rationale: Duplicate of blocker_type; captures the business-blocking facet of burden but overlaps.

per_column.name: data_risk_or_exposure
per_column.rationale: Duplicate of data_risk; captures the data-risk consequence facet but overlaps.

per_column.name: technical_root_cause_pattern
per_column.rationale: Duplicate of technical_root_cause; a cause external to the burden concept.

judge.rationale: Most added columns are external predictors or causes of burden (issue_category, request_type, system_component, technical_root_cause, is_outage), not constitutive parts of it. Only impact scope, data risk, and business-blocking severity function as true facets of operational burden. The set is heavily redundant: nearly every column appears twice under different names (is_outage/is_outage_or_incident, blocker_type/blocker_or_dependency, data_risk/data_risk_or_exposure, system_component/system_component_affected, technical_root_cause/technical_root_cause_pattern), destroying mutual exclusivity. Even among genuine facets there is overlap, and key constitutive dimensions of burden such as effort/time cost, volume/frequency, and reopen/escalation load are missing (resolution_minutes exists only in the original table, not as an added facet), so exhaustiveness is low.
